name: duchamp
description: Market-tested ad research for coding agents: working ads, keyframes and transcripts over MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Research the ads that are working, from your agent
interface.longDescription: Duchamp gives Codex the ads that are working for curated advertisers (running 90+ days, or in today's top 10 impression rank) with research materials: timestamped keyframes, the speech transcript, full body copy, the landing URL and observed numbers. Your agent does the analysis on your own Codex subscription. Duchamp does not reproduce ads.
defaultPrompt: Find long-running ads in my niche
Open this ad and read its keyframes and transcript
Compare my page with two competitors
